mapper.select: SELECT x.expense_id, d.dept_name, i.item_name, x.title, x.amount, emp.emp_name AS requester_name, DATE_FORMAT(x.req_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS req_date FROM expense x JOIN budget b ON b.budget_id = x.budget_id JOIN dept d ON d.dept_id = b.dept_id JOIN budget_item i ON i.item_id = b.item_id JOIN employee emp ON emp.emp_id = x.emp_id WHERE x.status = '대기' ORDER BY x.expense_id

SELECT h.hist_id, h.expense_id, x.title, h.action, emp.emp_name AS actor_name, DATE_FORMAT(h.action_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS action_at, h.memo FROM approval_history h JOIN expense x ON x.expense_id = h.expense_id JOIN employee emp ON emp.emp_id = h.actor_id ORDER BY h.hist_id DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee emp JOIN expense x ON x.expense_id = #{expenseId} JOIN budget b ON b.budget_id = x.budget_id WHERE emp.emp_id = #{actorId} AND emp.role = '결재자' AND emp.dept_id = b.dept_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO approval_history (expense_id, actor_id, action, memo) VALUES (#{expenseId}, #{actorId}, #{action}, #{memo,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
